{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
df_clean = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Compute average revenue per completed order
avg_revenue = df_clean['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Output
print(f'Average revenue per completed order: {avg_revenue:.2f} USD')"}
